## KaliScriber 0.6.0

Install the `arm64-v8a` APK on most phones (`universal` if unsure). It updates over earlier builds and keeps your meetings and settings.

### While you record
- **Speakers named as you go.** Every 10 minutes the live transcript is labelled with who is speaking. People you've saved in voice memory are named straight away. Names you give during the meeting stay when it ends, and so do speakers you merge. Lines not identified yet say so instead of showing a random name.
- **Bookmarks.** Tap **Mark** on the recording screen, or **Bookmark** in the notification, when something important is said, and add a quick note if you like. Marks appear in the transcript, in a **Your bookmarks** card on the summary and in exported notes, and the running notes and summary give those moments extra weight.
- **Calendar.** If your Baikal or CalDAV calendar is set up (Settings → Export → Calendar & tasks), a recording started during an event takes its title and the number of people invited. The invitees' names help the AI name speakers. Turn this off with **Use this calendar for meetings**.

### New
- **Answers stream in.** Ask and Ask all meetings show the answer as the AI writes it, with every provider (Command Code, OpenAI-compatible, Claude, Ollama Cloud).
- **Meeting prep.** Home shows the meeting in progress or coming up next: who is invited, what is still open with them, a link to your last meeting with them, **Prepare** (asks across all meetings) and **Record**.
- **Share to KaliScriber.** Share a recording, voice note or video from another app, or open an audio file with KaliScriber, and it becomes a meeting that is transcribed and summarised in the background.
- **Quick Settings tile and home-screen widget.** Start recording in one tap. Both show when a meeting is recording, and the widget shows the running time.
- **Processing details.** In a meeting's menu: each step with how long it took, including the work done while recording, and how long the meeting took to be ready after you stopped.

### Faster
- **Faster speaker detection.** Voiceprints now come from NeMo TitaNet small, which tells voices apart as well as before and runs about a third faster. The new model (40 MB) downloads on Wi-Fi, or when you next record, and the old one is removed.
- **Saved voices carry over.** Voices saved in voice memory are learned again with the new model, in the background, from your latest meetings with each person. A voice with no recordings left on the phone shows in Settings until you name that person in a meeting again.
